scope: Three bounded starting catalogs and all five archived Annot buy catalogs. Metadata/crafting closure does not implement all equipment, consumables or deployables; no sell/buyback.
conditions: UIShopWnd.UpdataShop leaves bPass true for type1 limits even without completed missions. Type2 rows are not included.
refresh: On open, strict elapsed>refresh_seconds resets stock; each nonempty entry resets creation time even when not refreshed.
